title: Photo 051 · 아워글래스 USSBBW · 나전칠기 · 쪼그려 앉기 3/4 · 라틴 40대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Latina woman in her late 40s, faint lines at the eyes and mouth, warm golden-tan skin tone with olive undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a short cropped pixie cut, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears long chain earrings and has rounded nails with a deep gloss.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so wide that her hips are cut off by the left and right edges of the frame. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — a shadowed groove running around her middle, the one place on her body where the outline pulls inward. Below that waistline an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops straight down between her parted knees under its own weight, settling onto the tops of her thighs and spreading down toward the floor, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds as it compresses, deep shadowed creases between them, the surface soft and uneven, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum. It merges seamlessly into her sides, her hips and her thighs with no boundary anywhere, one continuous body rather than a separate mass, not pregnant. Colossal hips more than three times the width of that waistline and a gigantic rounded rear, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves, very thick upper arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body and her hands look small against her thighs. Wide at the bust, drawn in at the waistline, wide again below: the silhouette reads as a great hourglass at the most extreme size. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The flesh is softer and looser at this age, each fold hanging lower and settling further over the one below it. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how it drops, compresses and presses out to the sides wherever two parts of her body meet.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a coarser surface grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, crepey texture in the deepest folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer — glossy black lacquer covered with shimmering iridescent mother-of-pearl arabesque vines, peonies and cranes glowing pink, aqua and silver, wide mother-of-pearl bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense scrolls filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Squatting low and turned about 45 degrees from the camera with the front of her body still mostly toward the lens, her face toward the camera, balanced on the balls of her feet with the heels of her shoes lifted clear of the floor, her knees pushed wide apart by the bulk of her own thighs, her back straight, the enormous rear settling down low behind her seen in partial profile, her hands resting on her knees with her arms held clear of her body, full body head to feet filling the frame.

Footwear: Extreme iridescent pearl-white platform stiletto sandals with toe rings, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the mother-of-pearl shimmering with rainbow iridescence, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide.
